issues.jp_before: 見[み]て、黒板[こくばん]{に|ni-location}変[へん]な絵[え]{が|ga-subject}書[か]いてあります。
issues.problem: A picture is drawn (描く), not written (書く).
issues.action: Changed 書[か]いて to 描[か]いて.

issues.jp_before: 隣[となり]{の|no-possessive}席[せき]{の|no-possessive}人[ひと]{が|ga-subject}急[きゅう]に立[た]ち上[あ]がりました。
issues.problem: Distractor は is acceptable in narration when the person is already known ('The person ...'), so the blank had two answers.
issues.action: Deleted and replaced with 授業中、後ろの席で誰かがくしゃみをしました (誰か cannot take は); same skill ga-subject.

issues.jp_before: 先生[せんせい]{が|ga-sub-clause}書[か]いた本[ほん]{は|wa-topic}とても有名[ゆうめい]です。
issues.problem: の is equally natural for the subject of a relative clause (先生の書いた本).

issues.problem: の is equally natural in the relative clause (兄の使っていた辞書).

issues.jp_before: 彼[かれ]{が|ga-sub-clause}作[つく]った資料[しりょう]{は/が|wa-topic}とても分[わ]かりやすいです。
